_about: Profiles for Slack's 'Suggest domains' buttons. main_domain is the client's REAL site (used only to reject lookalike names - the client's brand never appears in a sending domain). Names are built from the business, by role: lead_words go first (describe: postal, clean, outbound), head_nouns go last (things: records, catalog, meetings), related are on-topic words that may sit anywhere. Every suggestion must contain at least one of these words and read as '<word> + <noun>'. ai_seeds are the 3-word prompts sent to Zapmail's AI Domain Finder - plain words about what the client does, not jargon. keywords is the short summary shown in Slack. Edit freely; no code change needed.
